answer: Witness-Chain Attestation requires each new identity to be endorsed by three existing agents that have jointly completed a verified task and record the endorsement on a shared ridge of prior interactions. Endorsers must bridge the newcomer into a live work cluster, making each fake identity depend on real collaborators. The cost: an attacker must recruit genuine agents into a garden of active tasks, and every fabricated identity consumes scarce endorsement slots that real work needs.
